FileSpaceDef.description: str? @desc(邏輯檔案空間用途說明)
FileSpaceDef.include: list[uri]! | extend @desc(納入空間掃描之根目錄或檔案語意 URI 清單)
FileSpaceDef.exclude: list[uri]? | extend @desc(排除掃描之子目錄或萬用字元語意 URI 清單)
FileSpaceDef.file_patterns: list[str]? | extend @desc(允許納入之檔案副檔名或 Glob 樣式清單 (如 *.py, *.md))
FileSpaceDef.hash_policy: enum(adaptive, full_hash, stat_only, lazy_stabilized)? = adaptive @desc(檔案指紋雜湊計算策略)
FileSpaceDef.large_file_threshold_mb: int? = 10 @desc(大檔案自適應分流閾值 (MB))
FileSpaceDef.follow_symlinks: bool? = false @desc(掃描時是否跟隨符號連結目錄)
FileSpaceDef.watch: bool? = true @desc(是否由背景常駐服務即時監聽變更)
FileSpaceDef.weight: float? = 1.0 @desc(空間檢索預設權重係數)

spaces.description: 向 file-space 模組註冊通用檔案空間幾何範圍、過濾規則與分級雜湊策略
